text: The robot handled 314 orders over a week, delivering one and encountering significant delays due to unknown failures affecting [cite:7] orders. Unknown issues were the primary reason for these failures, impacting both fast-moving items like pens and slower-moving ones such as t-shirts. Orders that took longer than usual often had warnings about item not found or [[reachability]] problems. To address this, focus on improving [[detection]] accuracy for commonly ordered items to reduce unknown failure rates.
